ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows two grayscale images of the same coastal or estuary delta region displayed side by side on the left and right, with a vertical separation in the middle. In the left image, relatively clear land boundaries, water systems, and coastline forms can be seen; in the right image, the brightness and darkness and surface condition of the same area have changed obviously, showing comparative images before and after the disaster. Then reason: the prompt states that this set of photos was released by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration NASA and is used to record surface changes before and after a tropical storm struck Myanmar. NASA usually obtains surface images from a long distance through sensors on satellites or spacecraft, which belongs to remote sensing among geographic information technologies, rather than field surveying or ordinary map drawing.

raw_record.question_text:
The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) released comparative photos before and after a tropical storm struck Myanmar. The left image is the scene photographed on April 15, 2009, and the right image is the picture photographed after the strike on May 5.

<image1>

What geographic information technology was used to obtain this set of photos?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：画面为左右并列的两张缅甸沿海/三角洲地区影像，左图较清晰显示灾前地表和水系，右图显示灾后地表状态变化。再读题干：这些照片由美国宇航局NASA公布，记录热带风暴袭击前后。根据NASA通过航天器或卫星传感器远距离拍摄地球表面的常识，判断获得这组照片的地理信息技术是遥感。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左右并列显示两幅同一沿海或河口三角洲地区的灰度影像，中间有竖向分隔。左图能看到较清晰的陆地边界、水系和海岸线形态；右图同一区域的亮暗和地表状态发生明显变化，表现为灾害前后对比影像。再推理：题干说明这组照片由美国宇航局 NASA 公布，用于记录热带风暴袭击缅甸前后的地表变化。NASA通常通过卫星或航天器上的传感器从远距离获取地表影像，这属于地理信息技术中的遥感，而不是实地测量或普通地图绘制。
